Subject: Billing & onboarding: PO vs card options — follow-up after call

Hi Susan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has a clear path: 

1) Procurement constraints you mentioned
   - Pegasus AP prefers Net30 PO for new vendors when contract > $10k annually.
   - For purchases under $10k you can do corporate card, but card program requires vendor acceptance of credit-card terms and a vendor profile (W-9 + ACH).
   - Marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace/GCP Marketplace) is allowed but needs legal confirmation — you said that shortens vendor onboarding.

2) Our proposals to keep momentum
   - Option A (Preferred for speed): Redwood lists Redwood Inference on Pegasus-approved marketplace (if IT/legal greenlights). Marketplace billing leaves Pegasus as payer and avoids PO creation.
   - Option B (Standard AP path): Sign SOW + Submit vendor setup form → Redwood receives PO (Net30) → Redwood invoices monthly.
   - Option C (Card-first pilot): Small pilot order on card (<= $10k) while vendor onboarding runs in parallel for future POs.

3) Attachments I’m sharing: draft MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones, and our vendor setup template (W-9 placeholder included).

Next steps I suggest:
- Susan: confirm whether Pegasus can approve marketplace purchases for initial pilot (yes/no by EOD Wed) and share the procurement contact who owns vendor setups.
- Marissa: once we have procurement contact, can you own the vendor-form cadence and estimate timeline?
- Ben: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept Net30 POs for the quoted SKU and whether we can set a temporary cap for card pilot?

Thanks — I’ll wait on the procurement contact and will update the MAP with target dates.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0184

Diego — thanks for the clear write-up. A couple clarifications from procurement side: 

- Marketplace: Pegasus procurement team will consider marketplace purchases for SaaS, but Legal needs to confirm acceptable terms. That usually takes 5–7 business days for an initial review. If legal approves, marketplace would be fastest.
- POs: Our standard is Net30 for approved vendors. For first-time vendors we also require completed vendor profile and W-9 before issuing a PO.
- Card: Corporate card purchases are allowed for up to $7,500 per transaction (not $10k as discussed on the call) unless we apply for an exception. We can do a card pilot but it will need AP to pre-approve the vendor's card acceptance.

Procurement contact: Jamie Lee (jamie.lee@pegasustech.com) will own vendor onboarding. I’m looping Jamie in below.

Happy to move forward on Option C (card pilot) for an initial POC if Redwood can accept the quicker card terms and provide a planned invoice cadence in parallel so AP can see how this converts to a PO once vendor profile completes.

Thanks,
Susan
Head of Partnerships | Pegasus Tech
